whatWorked: The Kurtosis lane provisioned the L1 execution and consensus clients, the L2 op-reth/op-node pair, op-batcher and op-proposer.
The L1 beacon chain and geth produced and verified empty blocks.
The L2 sequencer produced blocks and op-batcher published type-3 transactions carrying one blob each (blobs=1 in the batcher log).
The L2 chain id 16584 was configured and funded development accounts were reachable.

blocker.message: The consensus client expects 128 cell proofs for a blob block while the block carries one KZG proof (pre-Fulu format).
blocker.causeAnalysis: The pinned upstream optimism-package/ethereum-package revision (September 2025) generates a pre-Fulu genesis and uses floating or mismatched client images. The lighthouse versions that start against that genesis reject blob blocks with the Fulu cell-proof requirement, while the older lighthouse release that predates the check cannot start against the generated genesis. This is the image/genesis mismatch recorded in A05; it is upstream, not in the settlement contracts or the API.
affectedSteps: blob versioned hash / L1 receipt / beacon slot / sidecar commitment
L2 order block hash derived by a verifier from L1 blobs
unsafe/safe/finalized head sampling and L1 consensus finality
canonical portal withdrawal against consensus timers

impact: NET-01 evidence cannot be captured on this lane yet. A05's calldata lane remains the working local path and all settlement/API/AA evidence is unaffected.
nextOptions: Wait for an upstream optimism-package/ethereum-package image set whose genesis generator and lighthouse release agree on Fulu/PeerDAS cell proofs, then rerun devnet/net01/run.sh.
Pin a coherent image list copied from an ethpandaops release CI instead of floating client images.
Build the L1 consensus image set from the same source revision as the genesis generator once an upstream fix lands.
limitations: The blob DA, sidecar and consensus finality claims are not demonstrated and must not be inferred from this record.
The canonical portal withdrawal is not re-executed on this lane; A05 uses recorded clock acceleration on the calldata lane.
The blocker is in the upstream packaging/toolchain, not in the repository contracts, API or evidence schemas.
notes: This record exists so the failed attempts and their exact errors are durable and the lane can be retried reproducibly.
The local /tmp package patch that forced supernode=true was removed; keeping it would hide the real mismatch.
